meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: Claude 会把散乱的 GitHub issue 按根因归成少数几个 plan-master，给每个子 issue 贴统一重定向评论并以 not planned 关闭，再用一个 PR 一次性关掉整簇；最终让 open issue 数等于 plan 数。
howto.when: 当仓库累积了 20+ 个疑似重复或同一缺陷造成的 issue，或你要求 triage、consolidate、dedupe 等整理动作，或想把新报的 bug 归入已有计划时触发。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 open issue 按根因聚成几个 plan
say.note: 会先读全部 issue 正文和评论再聚类

say.text: 把这个新报的 bug 归到已有的 plan 里
say.note: 匹配后在 master 上追加 Round N 评论

say.text: 为 plan-02 发一个 PR，关掉它下面的子 issue
say.note: PR 正文用 Closes #N 自动关闭子 issue

howto.what_en: Claude groups a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes each child with a standard redirect comment, then ships one PR per cluster closing all children. End state: open issues equal open plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the tracker has 20+ issues that look like duplicates of one defect, when you ask to triage, consolidate or dedupe, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues in this repo by root cause into a few plans.
say_en.note: Reads every issue body and comment thread first

say_en.text: File this new bug into the matching existing plan.
say_en.note: Adds a Round N comment on the master

say_en.text: Ship a PR for plan-02 and close all its child issues.
say_en.note: PR body uses Closes #N to auto-close
